issues: Static validation 'ui primary flow' fails at step 51: after clicking 'Export PDF' the text 'Export ready to share' never appears. Cause confirmed in src/screens/ExportScreen.tsx: exportPdf() calls showSuccess(true), which navigates away to the Settings tab (navigation.navigate('Main', { screen: 'Settings' })) before/while the confirmation is shown, so the Export screen (and its message/Snackbar) unmounts — the flow's visible text is the Settings screen. Keep the user on the Export screen (or render the 'Export ready to share' confirmation on the destination) so the message is visible after Export PDF, exactly as it is after Export CSV.

Milestone 4 is entirely missing: there is no src/lib/backup.ts, BackupScreen, RestoreScreen, BackupButton or RestoreButton (grep over src/ finds no backup/restore code), so the required encrypted passphrase-protected backup/restore with integrity check and friendly wrong-passphrase message does not exist. The planned files list and ui_flow.json steps 52-77 ('Backup & restore', 'Create encrypted backup', 'Restore from backup', 'Delete all data' → 'All data deleted.') cannot pass.

Settings is incomplete versus the requirement and ui_flow.json: src/screens/SettingsScreen.tsx has no 'Backup & restore' button and no 'Delete all data' action with confirmation dialog (no call to store.clearAll() anywhere in the UI).

Exports are never shared: expo-sharing is not imported anywhere (grep finds no Sharing/shareAsync in src/), and generateCsv() only returns a string — it never writes a file. Requirement (5) says CSV and PDF must be generated on the device and shared through the share sheet; write the CSV to a file with expo-file-system and call Sharing.shareAsync for both CSV and PDF. Note expo-sharing/expo-file-system are installed but expo-sharing is not in package.json dependencies — add it.

Dashboard 'Estimated tax' is hard-coded to "$0.00" (src/screens/DashboardScreen.tsx line 65) and the mileage deduction uses the constant DEFAULT_MILEAGE_RATE from lib/mileage.ts instead of the user's configured rate from lib/settings.ts. Requirement (4) needs estimated tax computed from the configurable tax rate, clamped at never negative, and the mileage deduction computed at the configured rate.

Mileage rate default is inconsistent and unlabeled: lib/mileage.ts uses 0.585 while lib/settings.ts uses 0.655, and no screen shows the required "verify for your tax year" caveat. Settle on one current IRS standard business rate as the default and label it in Tax settings.

Receipt photos are not kept in the app's private storage and the camera path is missing: src/lib/photoPicker.ts only calls requestMediaLibraryPermissionsAsync/launchImageLibraryAsync (no launchCameraAsync, which requirement (2) makes the primary path) and stores the picker's temporary URI directly instead of copying the file into the app's document directory. It also reads result.cancelled/result.uri, which no longer exist in expo-image-picker 57 (the result is { canceled, assets: [{ uri }] } — see node_modules/expo-image-picker/build/ImagePicker.types.d.ts lines 342-359), so a picked photo is never returned.

src/@types/expo-image-picker.d.ts declares `declare module 'expo-image-picker' { const ImagePicker: any; export default ImagePicker }`, which shadows the package's real types and hides the API misuse above. Delete it and use the package's own types.

The App-lock toggle on the Settings screen (src/screens/SettingsScreen.tsx) only calls setLock local state; it never persists via setAppLockEnabled, so flipping it there silently does nothing after a restart (the separate AppLock screen does persist).

src/lib/exportCsv.ts swallows all errors and returns an empty/minimal CSV on failure, and ExportScreen therefore shows 'Export ready to share' even when nothing was produced. Let failures propagate so the 'Export failed. Try again.' state is real. The same pattern is in src/lib/exportPdf.ts, which falls back to a dummy 'data:application/pdf;base64,JVBERi0xLjQK' URI.
feedback: Acceptance tests pass but static validation fails on the primary UI flow, so this must be revised. The main blocker is ExportScreen navigating to Settings after 'Export PDF' (confirmed: the flow's visible text at the failing step is the Settings screen), plus the whole of milestone 4 (backup/restore, delete all data) and share-sheet export being absent. Also fix the dashboard's hard-coded estimated tax, the configured-rate usage, the expo-image-picker 57 result shape/camera path and private-photo storage, and the Settings app-lock toggle not persisting.
